Specification: This specification defines a very small TLA+ module containing an operator-valued constant A and a constant b, along with a single top-level definition def == A(b). It does not model any transition system, algorithm, or fault-tolerant protocol, and it introduces no variables, actions, temporal formulas, or correctness properties. The file is essentially a minimal structural example showing application of an operator-valued constant to an argument.
